instruction: Find all image files in the 'photos' directory that are larger than 100KB and copy them into a directory named 'large_images'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding and copying image files larger than 100KB. Without exact file sizes, this evaluator checks that at least 1 file was moved to large_images directory. The actual number will depend on which images exceed 100KB threshold.
